source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), finish the Exorcist’s shooting, then test each enemy unit for Battle-shock if any of its **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/indirect-fire)** attacks hit it. When the Exorcist destroys a model with **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)**, lower the ability’s D6 threshold for **mortal wounds** from 6 to 5+.

effects.targets: enemy units hit by at least one attack from an Indirect Fire weapon

effects.trigger: owner attack destroys model with Deadly Demise
effects.effect: Deadly Demise roll for mortal wounds
